entries.name: Crossbred Thresher

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (Might). The seedling it sows when it breaks and the produce-interval roll are both capabilities, not stat lines, so the raw-stat share stays well under the fused-rung baseline.

entries.notes: A muzzle that keeps working after it is spent: atom.gardener's OnDeath trigger plants one last seedling where the graft finally gave out. Role-legal for armament-primary, but a spawn rider is not a shape the rolled pool draws often on this slot, which is the whole point of hand-placing it.

entries.name: Keg of Symbiosis

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (Vitality). The sun banked per hit taken is an economy capability, not a stat line, so the raw-stat share stays under the ceiling.

entries.notes: A scavenged keg strapped to the chest, rigged to hold grafted sap rather than anything a quartermaster issued. atom.econ-endure's role list is girdle / jewel-major / jewel-minor only — illegal for core-guard's rolled pool. Deliberately item.humanoid-torso-b-001 rather than any item.plant-stem base type: the plant-stem-a role/frame is already pinned by a set member elsewhere in the corpus (ssot-sets.md §3.8, a unique may never double up with a set on the same base-type identity).

entries.name: Twinyoke

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (the earth ward). Reflecting damage back at an attacker is a capability, not a stat line, so the raw-stat share stays under the ceiling.

entries.notes: A plant graft implanted on a humanoid shoulder, not armour bolted onto it — origin=rooted on a humanoid frame is deliberate, per verdant-graft's own register. atom.retribution's role list excludes ward-array; a pauldron that hits back is not a shape the rolled pool ever offers this slot.

entries.name: Stitched Corolla

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (Vitality). The ally-heal on death is a capability, not a stat line, so the raw-stat share stays under the ceiling.

entries.notes: Petals stitched shut around the graft's own dying gift: when this bloom falls, it feeds the squad rather than just the wearer. Both families are role-legal on jewel-major; the unique's value here is the fixed pairing, not a rule break.

entries.name: Spathe of the Ichor

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (Fortitude). The hypnotic pollen chance is a control capability, not a stat line, and is kept at the family's own recommended low band since a mind-control proc must not compound.

entries.notes: The bract's ichor is scent, not blood: whatever it touches either follows or festers. atom.mesmerizing and atom.venomous are both role-legal on sense; kept at low band deliberately, per that family's own sizing note.

entries.name: Hybridrhizome

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (Fortitude). Shedding a harmful status when struck is a utility capability, not a stat line, so the raw-stat share stays under the ceiling.

entries.notes: A rootstock grown from two natures grafted end to end, shedding whatever the soil tries to leave in it. Both families are role-legal on footing.

entries.name: Welted Cistern

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (Vitality). The sun skimmed per hit landed is an economy capability, not a stat line, so the raw-stat share stays under the ceiling.

entries.notes: Neither Vitality nor atom.econ-graze is on infusion's rolled role list — a gland sac that banks sun with every strike lands is not a shape the pool would ever hand this slot on its own.

entries.name: Implanted Scion

counterPressure.note: One raw-stat line (Might). The reinforcement spawned on death is a capability, not a stat line, so the raw-stat share stays under the ceiling.

entries.notes: A cutting implanted into the retinue line: when it falls, something new roots where it fell. Neither Might nor atom.summoner is on retinue's rolled role list, which is exactly what makes a runner that raises its own reinforcement a unique rather than a stronger runner.
